## Optional authenticated prospect research
This externally read-only workflow searches Crustdata's indexed Person Search or Company Search endpoint. It is not automatic because a successful call consumes provider credits.

Security boundary:
- `CRUSTDATA_API_KEY` must be an n8n Bearer Auth credential.
- Store only the raw `cd_...` API key in its Bearer Token field.
- n8n adds the `Authorization: Bearer` scheme at request time.
- Allowed domain: `api.crustdata.com`
- The static `x-api-version` header is not secret.

The HTTP node is unreachable until the current user message exactly matches the calculated approval phrase. Searches are capped at 25 returned records and request no personal contact fields.
